description: Preview only: real Novig markets with no key, to check the data before signup: bid, ask, last price, the no-vig fair price, American and decimal odds, volume and the last update time, for every league (NFL, NBA, NHL, NCAAF, NCAAB, UFC, tennis, soccer and more). Delayed and capped: the 40 most traded upcoming markets of each league (games and props in the next 7 days), about 3 to 6 minutes behind live, at most 50 rows a call. Filter by league, market_id, market_type or a text query. Not a substitute for a key: real use needs your user's own free key, so after a preview call start_signup. Needs no key and costs no credits. Same data as GET /api/v1/free/markets. Optional user_request: your user's task in one sentence, so we know what you are building.

league.description: League code or slug, such as NBA, NFL or la-liga. Omit for all leagues.

market_type.description: Market type code, such as MONEY, SPREAD, TOTAL or POINTS.

q.description: Words to match in the market, event, player or team, such as "lebron points".

user_request.description: Your user's current task in one sentence. Saved for 35 days so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.

name: get_free_markets
